Shri Prasanna R. Bhatnagar - Advocate for the petitione
 Shri Anirudha Malpani Ga for State.

Order 
With the consent of parties, matter is heard finally.
The present petition is filed against the award dated 30.07.2014 passed by Labour Court, Ratlam whereby claim of the petitioner against termination from service has been rejected.
The petitioner was appointed on 01.04.1985 as Watchmen under Respondent deparment.
Thereafter on 21.02.2006 services of the petitioner were regularized.
The salary of the petitioner was fixed by the respondent as Rs.5,500/- per months in regular pay scale.
The petitioner served the respondents continuously for a period of 28 years.

During his service tenure a written complaint was filed by the Assistant Engineer, PHE Department dated 23.04.2012 to Police Station Jaora City alleging therein that the petitioner has misplaced 200 Pipes from the godown of respondent department.
On receipt of such complaint Police authority investigated into the matter and filed charge sheet U/s 408, 420, 109, 120-B of I.P.C. against the petitioner and other person.
That, on registration of criminal case the respondent terminated the services of petitioner vide order dated 15.05.2012.
That, the petitioner continuously performed his job with due diligence and without any fault.

The respondent was satisfied by the work of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:32144 2 WP-5492-2015 petitioner.

Unfortunately his services were terminated by the respondent on 15.05.2012 without issuing any show cause and without affording any Shabbir Hussain vs Public Health Engineering Department on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114582879/
1 opportunity of hearing in gross violation of the principles of natural justice whereas, petitioner did not commit any crime.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
That, being aggrieved by said termination order the petitioner filed statement of claim before learned Labour Court Ratlam bearing case No. 20/2012 1.D. (Reference)
for reinstatement in service which has been dismissed by the impugned award.
Counsel for the petitioner argued that during the pendency of the petition the aforesaid criminal case has been decided and in the said criminal case he has been acquitted.
Counsel for the State pointed out that after acquittal the petitioner had filed an application before the employer but the same has not been decided.
Counsel for the State submits that pending application of the petitioner will be considered and decided by the employer in accordance with law.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties,the petition is disposed off with liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh detail and comprehensive representation before the Executive Engineer, PHE, Ratlam within a period of 15 days from today along with order of acquittal and the judgments passed by the courts on which the petitioner proposes to rely.

On filing fresh representation, the said authority shall consider and decide the said representation in accordance with law within a period of 60 days therefrom by passing a reasoned and speaking order without being influenced by the award passed by the Labour Court.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE MK Shabbir Hussain vs Public Health Engineering Department on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114582879/
